I also need to consider the workplace dynamics. If this is affecting our work relationship, it might be worth involving a manager or HR, but only if the situation doesn't improve after I've tried to resolve it myself. In the future, I should practice better stress management and communication techniques to handle such situations more effectively. Taking a deep breath before reacting can make a big difference in how I respond. Overall, I realize that reacting with anger wasn't the best approach. I should focus on resolving the issue calmly and professionally to maintain a positive working relationship.
